verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is an international law firm whose core product is legal advisory services. Self-hosting is a software-deployment axis and is a category error for a professional-services firm. The evidence shows no self-hostable core software; a small online investor-readiness tool and downloadable cap-table templates are ancillary resources, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
